newsitem.title: USA: MetLife 1996 net income $853 mln, up 22 pct.
newsitem.headline: MetLife 1996 net income $853 mln, up 22 pct.

text.p: Metropolitan Life Insurance Co said Tuesday its consolidated net income for 1966 rose 22 percent to $853 million from 1995.
MetLife, the leading provider of life insurance in North America, said consolidated total revenues for 1996 reached $23.2 billion, up from $21.9 billion in 1995.
It said consolidated investment income was $8.8 billion, an increase of $137 million over 1995.
It said its consolidated pre-tax earnings on continuing operations for the year rose to $1.4 billion. Both pre-tax and post-tax resutls were company records, it said.
It said assets under management by the company and its affiliates rose by more than $100 billion in 1996, hitting $298 billion.

It said that the increase was largely due to the company's acquisition during the year of a majority stake in in New England Investment Cos, LP, through MetLife's merger with New England Mutual Life Insurance Co.
Strong performances by MetLife's international and money management operations also contributed to the increase, it added.

During the year, it said it maintained its position as the leading provider of life insurance in North America, with life insurance in force increasing to $1.6 trillion, up from $1.4 trillion in 1995.
It said total policyholder benefits, including dividends, were $17.1 billion in 1996, compared to $16.9 billion in 1995.
